ns2:section.sectionText: SP22 ESE 360 equips students to write about the environment for various audiences, with a focus on state and local issues. We will practice effective techniques for each stage of the writing process-from defining topics, to gathering information, to crafting active, engaging prose. Readings will include models of effective environmental writing and "how to" pieces by experts. Research will include student-conducted interviews with subjects. Course Information: Same as ENGL 360. Prerequisite: Completion of campus Composition I general education requirement.
